props.name: alwaysBouncing
props.description: Allow bouncing even when the content is smaller than the viewport.

props.name: bounces
props.description:
Enable native bounce on iOS / Harmony / PC. Ignored when
`enableBounces` turns on the custom main-thread bounce.

props.name: enableBounceEventInFling
props.description:
Fire `scrollToBounces` when the bounce is reached during a fling, not
only during a finger-down drag.

props.name: enableBounces
props.description:
Turn on the custom main-thread bounce/overscroll system. When `false`
(default) the component is a thin wrapper that only forwards the native
`bounces` prop.

props.name: enableRTL
props.description: Mirror horizontal bounce direction for RTL layouts.

props.name: endBounceTriggerDistance
props.description:
Overscroll distance (px) past the lower edge required to fire
`scrollToBounces` with `{ direction: 'lower' }`.

props.name: estimatedHeight
props.description: Size hint (px) used by the bounce maths before the first layout pass.

props.name: estimatedWidth
props.description: Horizontal size hint (px) used before first layout.

props.name: id
props.description:
Stable id for the scroll container. Required by the bounce system to
select the container / bounce wrappers on the main thread. Auto-generated
when omitted.

props.name: lowerThreshold
props.description: Distance (px) from the lower edge that fires `scrollToLower`.

props.name: startBounceTriggerDistance
props.description:
Overscroll distance (px) past the upper edge required to fire
`scrollToBounces` with `{ direction: 'upper' }`.

props.name: upperThreshold
props.description: Distance (px) from the upper edge that fires `scrollToUpper`.

slots.name: upperBounceItem
slots.description: Overscroll indicator shown when pulling past the upper edge.

slots.name: lowerBounceItem
slots.description: Overscroll indicator shown when pulling past the lower edge.
